highlights:
Dating app Ditto, a new iMessage-based platform, has secured $9.2 million in seed funding. 

Dating app Ditto has raised $9.2 million in a seed funding round led by Peak XV Partners, with participation from Gradient, Scribble Ventures, Alumni Ventures and Llama Venture. Founded by Berkeley undergraduates Allen Wang and Eric Liu, Ditto is an iMessage-based matchmaking startup focused on planning real-world dates for college students. “When you remove swiping and chatting, you remove a lot of the toxicity and anxiety that people associate with online dating. We plan the date, people show up, and real connections have a chance to form. Around 20 per cent of our matches turned into actual dates,” said Allen Wang, CEO and co-founder of Ditto.
